scenario.name: CISA AA24-045A & Cisco Talos — 8Base / Phobos Ransomware: SmokeLoader Delivery, Process Hacker (kprocesshacker.sys) Service Kill & AES-256 Encryption (.8base)
scenario.overview: Imagine a lively downtown city street intersection with painted zebra crosswalks, glowing red-yellow-green traffic lights, corner shop awnings, and passing yellow taxis. At the busy downtown street corner, an impostor wearing a reflective utility vest kneels beside the metal traffic-signal control cabinet while pedestrians cross the street. In this real-world scenario, the intruder bypasses the normal inspection rule to reach the street-corner traffic signal box, then smuggles copied records out past the marked pedestrian crosswalk in tiny disguised batches. The city intersection camera and municipal traffic control board detect the impossible all-green light timing and dispatch a traffic officer immediately. In this scenario (T1055, CISA AA24-045A & Cisco Talos - 8Base / Phobos Ransomware: SmokeLoader Delivery, Process Hacker , kprocesshacker.sys Service Kill & AES-256 Encryption .8base), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: smokeLoader / SystemBC SOCKS5 Proxy, then uAC Bypass, Windows Firewall Disablement, then phobos AES-256-CBC Encryption.8base. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering SmokeLoader / SystemBC SOCKS5 Proxy, then UAC Bypass, Windows Firewall Disablement, then Phobos AES-256-CBC Encryption.8base, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 6 with the documented host and network chain.

stages.subtitle: Defense Evasion & Impact Preparation (T1562.004 - Disable Firewall / T1490)
stages.description: Opening the unlocked cabinet panel, the impostor rewires the corner traffic light timer so every lane turns green at once and steers a yellow taxi down a side alley. Here in Step 2 inside the city street, the intruder bypasses the normal inspection rule to reach the street-corner traffic signal box without disturbing the neighboring sidewalk cafe. The Phobos/8Base payload copies itself to %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup and HKLM\...\Run for persistence, disables the Windows Firewall via netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off, and executes vssadmin, wmic, wbadmin, and bcdedit in a tight loop to prevent system recovery (logged in Sysmon Event 1 with FirewallModification=netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off, RecoveryInhibition=vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + wbadmin + bcdedit, StartupPersistence=Startup Folder + HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). On the diagram, follow Step #2 / Link #2 (#2→ netsh.exe advfirewall set allprofiles state off / ⇠#2 ACK 1) from Node ② (#2 Perimeter Firewall & NDR Tap) to Node ③ (#3 ProcessHacker.exe (kprocesshacker.sys)), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 Enterprise Shares (.8base + info.hta)).

steps.plainTitle: UAC Bypass, Windows Firewall Disablement (netsh) & Shadow Copy / Boot Recovery Wipe
steps.storyAnalogy: Opening the unlocked cabinet panel, the impostor rewires the corner traffic light timer so every lane turns green at once and steers a yellow taxi down a side alley. Here in Step 2 inside the city street, the intruder bypasses the normal inspection rule to reach the street-corner traffic signal box without disturbing the neighboring sidewalk cafe.
steps.simpleExplanation: The Phobos/8Base payload copies itself to %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup and HKLM\...\Run for persistence, disables the Windows Firewall via netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off, and executes vssadmin, wmic, wbadmin, and bcdedit in a tight loop to prevent system recovery (logged in Sysmon Event 1 with FirewallModification=netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off, RecoveryInhibition=vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + wbadmin + bcdedit, StartupPersistence=Startup Folder + HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact).
